depth.quote: The 6800-foot (6010 m water equivalent) overburden of the SNOLAB site eliminates neutrons of cosmogenic origin.

exposure.quote: Twenty single nuclear recoil event candidates and three multiple bubble events were observed during a total exposure of 553 kg-days distributed over three different bubble nucleation thresholds.

target_mass.quote: New data are reported from the operation of a 4.0 kg CF$_{3}$I bubble chamber in the 6800-foot-deep SNOLAB underground laboratory.

summary.plain: A two-litre jar of superheated CF3I watched by cameras and microphones; bubbles from alpha particles sound louder than those from a WIMP-like nuclear recoil.
summary.technical: Synthetic fused-silica bell jar in the stainless-steel pressure vessel of COUPP-2kg, CF3I (3.5 kg at Fermilab, 4.0 kg at SNOLAB), piezoelectric acoustic sensors, cameras, water shield (and a liquid-scintillator muon veto at the Fermilab site).

technology.quote: Using synthetic silica for the bell jar served to reduce the alpha background wall rate from 0.7 events/cm2 /day in the natural quartz 2 kg chamber to immeasurably low levels in the 4 kg chamber
technology.value: Superheated CF3I bubble chamber (synthetic fused-silica jar) with cameras and piezoelectric acoustic sensors
